subject: Finova - Decision criteria: latency / cost / SLA clarification and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@finova.com>, Tom Jenkins <tom.jenkins@finova.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Finova - Decision criteria: latency / cost / SLA clarification and next steps

Hi Sarah / Tom — great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call with your app/infra team.

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary decision criteria: latency (p95), cost per active user/1M tokens, and deployment mode (hosted vs dedicated vs private).
- Security & procurement: SOC 2 evidence and data residency are gating items.
- Timeline: procurement + security review targeted for late Oct; technical deep-dive next week.

Proposed next steps
1) Can you confirm p95 latency target and an acceptable cost range for a 1M-token monthly workload? (Example targets below)
   - Performance target A: 200-250ms p95 (dedicated, NVLink/High perf)
   - Performance target B: 300-400ms p95 (dedicated/cost-optimized)
2) Can you share who needs to be engaged from procurement/security/economic buyer?
3) We'll share a short security questionnaire summary and a dedicated pricing worksheet ahead of the technical deep-dive.

Attachments: none in this message — we'll send the questionnaire and pricing workbook after aligning internally.

Thanks — available to coordinate times for next week.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tom Jenkins <tom.jenkins@finova.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Sep 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finova - Decision criteria: latency / cost / SLA clarification and next steps

Thanks Marissa — really helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Latency target: our goal is 300ms p95 end-to-end for the user flow (inference + network). We understand dedicated/private will be needed to reliably hit lower p95s.
- Cost: our procurement will evaluate $ / 1M tokens; target is to keep total inference spend under $X / month for pilot (we'll share a number internally this week).
- SLA: we need to understand what SLA Redwood can offer for Dedicated (targets & credits).
- Security: please provide a short summary of SOC 2 coverage + any data residency options. We'll also need a completed security questionnaire from your security team.

Stakeholders: I'll loop in key folks once we have the answers. For now the economic buyer is likely Anil Kapoor (CFO), technical lead is Tom (cc'd), and procurement handles contract steps.

Can you confirm if Redwood can meet 300ms p95 on Dedicated and what the ballpark delta vs hosted looks like? Also attach the SOC 2 summary and pricing workbook when you have them.

Thanks,
Sarah Liu
Head of Product, Finova
sarah.liu@finova.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@finova.com>, Tom Jenkins <tom.jenkins@finova.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finova - Decision criteria: latency / cost / SLA clarification and next steps

Thanks Sarah — answers and attached artifacts below. Quick answers up front:
- Latency: For Dedicated with the configuration we discussed (2 x A100-ish equivalent + optimized KV cache and batching), we can consistently target ~250ms p95 for your pilot workload. For Hosted, typical p95 is higher (350-450ms) depending on traffic and co-tenancy.
- Cost: Attached is a dedicated pricing worksheet with two bands: Standard (no commit) and Reserved (monthly commitment discounts). The sheet includes per-1M-token ballparks for the pilot configuration.
- SLA: We offer an SLA for Dedicated (99.9% uptime) with service credits; higher SLAs can be quoted for Reserved contracts. I'll have legal send the exact wording with the proposal.
- Security: Attached is a 2-page SOC2 coverage summary and a short answers doc for common questionnaire items. We also support VPC/deployed-private options for data residency.

Attachments (attached to this thread): Finova_Security_Questionnaire_Summary.pdf; redwood_dedicated_pricing.xlsx

Next steps
- Can you confirm the economic buyer and procurement contact so we can prepare an initial commercial mark and a short SOW?
- I'll coordinate with Rishi (cc) and David (cc) to schedule a technical deep-dive next week (30-60m). Rishi / David: do you have availability Tue/Wed afternoon PT?

If helpful I can also provide a short perf baseline report from a comparable fintech customer.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Finova_Security_Questionnaire_Summary.pdf, redwood_dedicated_pricing.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Finova - Decision criteria: latency / cost / SLA clarification and next steps

Team — forwarding Sarah's note. Key asks: confirm we can commit to ~250ms p95 on Dedicated for pilot, and prepare a commercial mark with a Reserved vs Standard pricing comparison. Procurement will expect pricing by early next week.

Suggested internal actions:
- Rishi: prepare an initial Reserved pricing mark with 6/12 month commit options and a recommended concession (we should anticipate discount discussion with a CFO).
- David: put together the perf baseline from the comparable fintech pilot and a short note on expected infra footprint + sequence length assumptions.

We should also have Legal ready to share SLA wording once procurement confirms they want Dedicated. I'm happy to join any call with procurement.

Marissa
